_note: Public/direct API list-price per-token rates (NOT via LiteLLM). Computed as a second 'external' cost alongside the contracted rates in rates.json. Keys are canonical `provider:model` — the loader strips any LiteLLM route prefix (aws/, bedrock/, azure/, vertex/, …) and context-window tag before lookup. Default OpenAI rates are standard GPT-5.5 API prices; override via SPOTLIGHTS_EXTERNAL_RATES_FILE for long-context, regional, or future price changes. Never substitute CLI-reported total_cost_usd.

anthropic:claude-opus-4-8.note: Public Anthropic API list price: Claude Opus 4.8 $5.00/MTok input, $25.00/MTok output, $0.50/MTok cache read (~0.1x), $6.25/MTok 5m cache write (1.25x). Override for 1h cache writes.

anthropic:claude-opus-5.note: Public Anthropic API list price: Claude Opus 5 $5.00/MTok input, $25.00/MTok output, $0.50/MTok cache read, $6.25/MTok 5m cache write (1.25x). Override for 1h cache writes ($10/MTok).

anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.note: Public Anthropic API list price: Claude Sonnet 5 $2.00/MTok input, $10.00/MTok output, $0.20/MTok cache read (0.1x), $2.50/MTok 5m cache write (1.25x). Override for 1h cache writes. Priced because aws/claude-sonnet-5 is on the proxy and is the cheap model for calibration runs; there is no contracted row for it in rates.json, so a Sonnet run's amount_usd stays partial until the contracted rate is supplied.

openai:codex.note: CLI-family fallback for Codex invocations whose stream did not emit a resolvable model id; same rate as openai:gpt-5.5 because gpt-5.5 is the model behind every codex invocation in this deployment. Public OpenAI API list price for standard GPT-5.5: $5.00/MTok input, $30.00/MTok output, $0.50/MTok cached input; no cache-create bucket. GPT-5.5 long-context (>272K input tokens) and some regional endpoints have different rates, so override via SPOTLIGHTS_EXTERNAL_RATES_FILE if those apply.

openai:gpt-5.5.note: Public OpenAI API list price for standard GPT-5.5: $5.00/MTok input, $30.00/MTok output, $0.50/MTok cached input; no cache-create bucket. Used when the Codex stream emits msg.model=gpt-5.5; identical rates to the openai:codex CLI-family fallback.
